I ended up getting an Xbox One on launch day because I happened to be at a store right when it opened. I'm curious how many people own both consoles, and what you think of the overall experience.

Not owning a PS4, I'd like to know how much the UI/etc. has changed. Plus, for people who own both consoles, how would you compare them? How similar are they?

I'm not interested in the "PS4 vs. Xbox One" attitude, or "Consoles vs. PC." Hopefully Voat will be above that. It gets in the way of us all enjoying the same thing.
XB1/PS4 owners: are you happy with your console, and how much has the experience changed since launch?

Xbox One released with some obvious things not implemented yet, but I'm happy with what Microsoft has done since then. There have been steady updates to refine things and add features that the community requested. Major Nelson was awesome about interacting on the XB1 subreddit...hopefully he shows up on Voat! (Edit: He's here!)

I'd have to say my favorite current-gen feature is the Game DVR. I love being able to easily record and share cool things that happen in a game.

I'll admit, I'm jealous that PS4 consistently runs games at higher settings. It sounds like XB1 will get a boost in the near future from DirectX (and reallocating resources away from Kinect) so hopefully that's true.
Also backwards compatibility! If I wasn't so goddamn poor id have one by now.
You have plenty of time. The list of compatible games is small until they release the feature to everyone (and not just Preview Program members).

Oh yeah you're totally right man I'm in no rush. Especially with college comin up this fall it might be a big distraction but I'm definitely getting one in the next year or so. The evr is something in particularly excited about

I purchased a PS4 about 10 months after release and I've been able to steadily keep up with games as they are released with a minimal backlog. This is fantastic since I missed out on most of the last gen and had tons of games sitting there waiting to be played.

In the last year there hasn't been much of a difference at all in PS4. I really do love the addition of continuing where I left off when I put my PS4 in rest mode but it is a little annoying if more than one person uses the PS4. Gotta be careful to save often.

I'm not worried about PS4 having backwards capabilities. It is rather strange that the systems DON'T actually have it (yes I know Xbox is getting it). But I did have time to go back and play everything I wanted to so I'm not missing out on anything.

So yes, I am happy with my PS4.

I'm glad to hear that PS4 is good for other reasons than graphical superiority. I was tempted to abandon my gamerscore and Xbox friends, and give Sony another chance. I still have fond memories of how great PS2 was!

Backward compatibility is a cool feature that I doubt I personally will use much. Still, they made the effort because the community wanted it so much...I like that.

I'm in the Xbox One preview program, and they do a lot of cool things in exchange for people testing (essentially) the beta version of the UI before an update goes out. I get random download codes for games that aren't out yet, and beta codes for things like the Gears Of War beta.
I own a PS4 and I'm very happy with it. There are awesome games on it, and the controller is nice.

The controller looks cool! I'm jealous of some last-gen/current-gen games that are PS exclusives.

The sad thing is, most of my friends who game are on PS3 or PS4. I've made quite a few online friends, though.

The controller is definitely an improvment, I was on the fence about it before it was released. Thought the share button was the dumbest thing ever. Since owning it, I love it and the share button is super useful when I wish to take a screenshot or a video of something sool that just happened.
Got PS4 at launch. Now I'm thinking about selling it because it's become almost exclusively an expensive netflix player.

I own both. I was upset that the R2 button on the PS4 controller broke despite only being used lightly. I'm also disappointed in the PS4 exclusives so far but Bloodborne has been awesome. The Xbox One on the other hand is awesome. The controller is perfect for FPS games. The exclusives like Titanfall and Forza Horizon 2 are perfect. I'm hanging on to the PS4 because RPGs are my favorite genre. Can't wait for that FF7 remake.
